# StickDrift

> Turn every phone in the room into a game controller. A game (the host) opens a room on a Cloudflare relay and shows a QR code; each phone that scans it becomes a gamepad (d-pad, stick, buzzer, quiz buttons, tilt wheel, touchpad, or a custom layout) whose input reaches the game as 16-byte snapshots over WebRTC peer-to-peer (~1 ms on a LAN) or the relay (~55-65 ms). No app, no accounts, no API key. (The name is a joke about worn analogue sticks drifting; touchscreens don't.)

Relay: https://stickdrift.net. Browser SDK: `import { StickDriftHost, pressed, held } from "https://stickdrift.net/sdk.js"` (types at `/sdk.d.ts`). Go: `github.com/jclement/stickdrift/go`, package `stickdrift`. Read presses as latched edges (`pressed(p, "A")` in JS, `JustPressed` after `Tick` in Go), not only held state.

## Start here

- [Agent integration guide](https://stickdrift.net/agents.md): step-by-step instructions to add phone controllers to a game, with checks at each step
- [Quickstart](https://stickdrift.net/docs/quickstart.md): a complete browser host in one HTML file, plus Go
- [Concepts](https://stickdrift.net/docs/concepts.md): rooms, hosts, pads, looks, phases, P2P vs relay

## Controllers

- [Layouts](https://stickdrift.net/docs/layouts.md): the ten built-in layouts, what each produces, preview URLs
- [Custom layouts](https://stickdrift.net/docs/custom-layouts.md): every control type and field for `layout: "custom"`
- [Themes](https://stickdrift.net/docs/themes.md): styles, fonts, shapes, colours
- [Avatars and banners](https://stickdrift.net/docs/avatars.md): show each player who they are
- [Haptics](https://stickdrift.net/docs/haptics.md): vibration patterns (Android only)

## Reference

- [SDKs](https://stickdrift.net/docs/sdks.md): JavaScript `StickDriftHost` and the Go package `stickdrift`
- [Protocol](https://stickdrift.net/protocol.md): WebSocket endpoints, JSON messages, the 16-byte input frame, WebRTC signalling
- [Layouts as JSON](https://stickdrift.net/api/v1/layouts)

## Guides

- [Recipes](https://stickdrift.net/docs/recipes.md): lobby/gameplay/spectator/results looks, player identity, 4-way grid games
- [Building party games](https://stickdrift.net/docs/party-games.md): how the four stickdrift.net games were built, with a starter prompt
- [Party-game skill](https://stickdrift.net/party-game-skill.md): an agent skill for building a same-screen party game (Go/wasm or JS, art and sound in code, optional voices, static hosting)
- [FAQ](https://stickdrift.net/docs/faq.md): iPhone full screen, latency numbers, guest Wi-Fi

## Tools

- [Demo host](https://stickdrift.net/demo): a working host showing every pad's live state, for testing
- [Layout designer](https://stickdrift.net/designer): build a custom layout visually and copy its JSON
- Preview any look without a room: `https://stickdrift.net/j?preview=<layout>&color=%23hex&style=<glass|neon|flat|retro|candy>&font=<display|sans|mono|pixel>&shape=<round|rounded|square>&bg=%23hex&text=%23hex`, and for custom layouts `/j?preview=custom#layout=<base64url JSON>`
